title: Better bats
description: This mod makes bat drop an item called 'raw bat' witch can be cooked into a cooked bat
body:
# Better bats
Better bats is a mod that adds two new items: raw bat and cooked bat.
## items
### Raw Bat
The raw bat item gives two nutrition and has a saturation modifier of 1.2. When consumed you will get the poison II effect for six seconds
### Cooked bat
The cooked bat item gives 8 nutrition and has a saturation modifier of 15. When consumed you get saturation II effect for one minute.
